examples.text: So geschwind als tunlich machte sich der Kriegsmann zu seinem Herrn zurück und verkündigte ihm die wunderliche Mär von der läutenden Schlange.
examples.translation: Thus the warrior returned to his lord as swiftly as possible, and told him the wondrous tale of the bell-ringing snake.
examples.english: Thus the warrior returned to his lord as swiftly as possible, and told him the wondrous tale of the bell-ringing snake.
